n_479dacae36732652.name: Find year and month folders
n_479dacae36732652.source: export default async function folder({root,previous},context){if(typeof root!=='string'||!root||root.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure the parent Drive folder');const now=new Date(),year=String(now.getUTCFullYear()),month=String(now.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');let s=previous??{phase:'year',parent:root,token:null,seen:[],found:null,year,month};if(!['year','month'].includes(s.phase)||!s.parent)throw Error('Invalid folder state');const name=s.phase==='year'?s.year:s.month,esc=x=>x.replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'");const q=`mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed = false and name = '${esc(name)}' and '${esc(s.parent)}' in parents`;const p=await context.actions.call('googledrive.files.list',{q,pageSize:1000,...(s.token?{pageToken:s.token}:{})});if(!Array.isArray(p.files))throw Error('Invalid folder results');let found=s.found;for(const f of p.files){if(!f.id||f.name!==name||f.mimeType!=='application/vnd.google-apps.folder'||found)throw Error('Ambiguous folder');found=f.id}const t=p.nextPageToken;if(t!==null&&(typeof t!=='string'||!t||s.seen.includes(t)))throw Error('Invalid folder cursor');if(t)return{state:{...s,token:t,found,seen:[...s.seen,t]},more:true,folderId:''};if(!found)throw Error('Required year or month folder not found');if(s.phase==='year')return{state:{...s,phase:'month',parent:found,found:null,token:null,seen:[]},more:true,folderId:''};return{state:s,more:false,folderId:found}}

n_950371d09652ea03.name: Collect unread invoice IDs
n_950371d09652ea03.source: export default function pages({previous,messages,nextPageToken}){let s=previous??{ids:[],cursors:[],pages:0};if(messages!=null){if(!Array.isArray(messages)||messages.some(m=>typeof m?.messageId!=='string'||!m.messageId))throw Error('Invalid Gmail page');const ids=[...s.ids,...messages.map(x=>x.messageId)];if(new Set(ids).size!==ids.length||ids.length>5000)throw Error('Duplicate or excessive Gmail results');if(nextPageToken!==null&&typeof nextPageToken!=='string')throw Error('Invalid Gmail cursor');if(nextPageToken&&s.cursors.includes(nextPageToken))throw Error('Repeated Gmail cursor');s={ids,cursors:nextPageToken?[...s.cursors,nextPageToken]:s.cursors,pages:s.pages+1};if(s.pages>=100&&nextPageToken)throw Error('Gmail page limit reached');return{state:s,more:!!nextPageToken,pageToken:nextPageToken||null,ids:s.ids}}return{state:s,more:true,pageToken:null,ids:s.ids}}

n_87d216207e4db1b9.name: Prepare the next email
n_87d216207e4db1b9.source: export default function next({ids,previous,attachment}){if(!Array.isArray(ids)||ids.length>5000||ids.some(x=>typeof x!=='string'||!x)||new Set(ids).size!==ids.length)throw Error('Invalid messages');let s=previous??{index:0,files:[]};if(attachment!=null){if(s.index>=ids.length||attachment.messageId!==ids[s.index])throw Error('Message association failed');s={index:s.index+1,files:[...s.files,attachment]}}if(s.index>ids.length||s.files.length!==s.index)throw Error('Invalid progress');return{state:s,more:s.index<ids.length,messageId:ids[s.index]||'',files:s.files}}

n_e06ed71b004c92c9.name: Select the first attachment
n_e06ed71b004c92c9.source: export default function pick({expectedId,messageId,attachmentList,payload}){if(messageId!==expectedId||!Array.isArray(attachmentList))throw Error('Unexpected message');const a=attachmentList[0];if(!a)return{missing:true,remote:false,attachmentId:'',filename:'',mimeType:'application/octet-stream',size:0,inline:''};if(!Number.isSafeInteger(a.size)||a.size<0||a.size>52428800||typeof a.filename!=='string')throw Error('Invalid attachment');let inline='';if(!a.attachmentId){const found=[];const walk=p=>{if(!p||typeof p!=='object')return;if(p.partId===a.partId&&typeof p.body?.data==='string')found.push(p.body.data);for(const c of p.parts||[])walk(c)};if(a.partId==null)throw Error('Missing part ID');walk(payload);if(found.length!==1)throw Error('Missing or ambiguous inline part');inline=found[0]}return{missing:false,remote:!!a.attachmentId,attachmentId:a.attachmentId||'',filename:a.filename,mimeType:a.mimeType||'application/octet-stream',size:a.size,inline}}

n_118626f9b78650c4.name: Check attachment bytes
n_118626f9b78650c4.source:
import{Buffer}from'node:buffer';
export default async function stage({missing,remote,inline,transitUrl,size,messageId,attachmentId,downloadedMessageId,downloadedAttachmentId,downloadedSize,filename,mimeType},context){if(missing)return{attachment:{messageId,missing:true}};let bytes;if(remote){if(downloadedMessageId!==messageId||downloadedAttachmentId!==attachmentId||downloadedSize!==size||typeof transitUrl!=='string'||!/^https:\/\//.test(transitUrl))throw Error('Attachment association failed');const r=await context.fetch(transitUrl,{method:'GET'});if(!r.ok)throw Error('Attachment download failed');bytes=Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer())}else{if(typeof inline!=='string'||!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]*={0,2}$/.test(inline))throw Error('Invalid inline content');const s=inline.replace(/-/g,'+').replace(/_/g,'/').replace(/=+$/,'');bytes=Buffer.from(s,'base64');if(bytes.toString('base64').replace(/=+$/,'')!==s)throw Error('Invalid base64')}if(bytes.length!==size)throw Error('Incomplete attachment');return{attachment:{messageId,missing:false,filename,mimeType,contentBase64:bytes.length?bytes.toString('base64'):null}}}

n_3b5be1d573bb5966.name: Prepare the next file
n_3b5be1d573bb5966.source: export default function next({files,previous,folderId}){if(!Array.isArray(files))throw Error('Invalid files');const i=previous==null?0:previous.index+1;if(!Number.isInteger(i)||i<0||i>files.length)throw Error('Invalid progress');const f=files[i];if(f?.missing)throw Error('Message has no first attachment');if(f&&(!folderId||!f.messageId))throw Error('Missing folder or message');return{state:{index:i},more:!!f,messageId:f?.messageId||'',name:f?`Orlen ${f.filename||'attachment'}`:'attachment',mimeType:f?.mimeType||'application/octet-stream',contentBase64:f?.contentBase64??null,parents:[folderId]}}

n_e65ccda3fbf687d4.name: Confirm Drive link
n_e65ccda3fbf687d4.source: export default function receipt({id,webViewLink}){if(!id)throw Error('Drive did not return a file ID');return {link:webViewLink ?? null}}

n_adc07f64a9f28fed.name: Confirm the email is read
n_adc07f64a9f28fed.source: export default function confirm({expectedId,messageId,labelIds}){if(messageId!==expectedId||!Array.isArray(labelIds)||labelIds.includes('UNREAD'))throw Error('Gmail did not confirm mark as read');return {ok:true}}
